s1.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with cardiac arrhythmia
salient_findings: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
key_facts: Presented to the emergency department during the COVID-19 pandemic
Cardiac auscultation: Regular rate and rhythm without murmurs, rubs, or gallops
Pulmonary auscultation: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
ECG findings: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness with cardiac arrhythmia
salient_findings: Inspiratory crackles in bilateral bases of the lungs
Regular, narrow complex tachycardia with rate of 170 beats/min
key_facts: Presented to the emergency department during the COVID-19 pandemic
Cardiac auscultation: Regular rate and rhythm without murmurs, rubs, or gallops

ECG findings: Regular, narrow complex tachycardia

differentials: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
per_call: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction
Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction

shortlist.label: Atrial tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: ECG findings of regular, narrow complex tachycardia

shortlist.label: COVID-19 pneumonia
shortlist.why_kept: SARS-CoV-2 PCR test positive and respiratory symptoms

shortlist.label: Supraventricular tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: Palpitations and ECG findings consistent with SVT

shortlist.label: Atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia
shortlist.why_kept: ECG findings of long RP interval and short P-wave duration

shortlist.label: Viral myocarditis
shortlist.why_kept: Positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR test and cardiac symptoms

raw.rationale: The ECG findings of regular, narrow complex tachycardia with a long RP interval and superiorly directed P waves are consistent with atrioventricular nodal reentrant tachycardia (AVNRT), which is a type of supraventricular tachycardia.

rejected.label: Atrial tachycardia
rejected.why: The ECG findings do not show the typical P wave morphology of atrial tachycardia.

rejected.label: COVID-19 pneumonia
rejected.why: While the patient has a positive SARS-CoV-2 PCR test, the primary presentation is of a cardiac nature, not respiratory.

rejected.label: Supraventricular tachycardia
rejected.why: This is a broader category that includes AVNRT, but the specific ECG findings point more specifically to AVNRT.

rejected.label: Viral myocarditis
rejected.why: There is no evidence of myocardial inflammation or damage on the echocardiogram or in the clinical presentation to support this diagnosis.
